verdict.rationale: Ironclad documents a REST API for launching workflows, including bulk launch, from published templates, and for creating and interacting with workflows. Integrations can write structured data and update document versions, while the platform applies its approval and signature policies, so document generation is clearly API-driven. However, the evidence shows no explicit field-population payload, no explicit API call to send a document for signature, and API access requires a paid add-on, so complete coverage of the story is not shown. Missing for 10: documented field/attribute population in the launch request, an explicit API step for sending documents to signers, independent hands-on corroboration of programmatic generation, and API availability without the add-on gate.
